title: AgentEvent
description: Schema for typed event records emitted by the ROOT Harness event stream during workflow execution. The CAS Application and MCP clients subscribe via subscribe_events to receive these records in real time. The event taxonomy is CAS-specific, reflecting the steward/orchestrator model rather than a generic trace vocabulary. Seven categories: workflow lifecycle, node transitions, tool interactions, LLM cycles, interrupt lifecycle, steward governance, and checkpoint operations. See CAS-ADR-013.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event. Assigned by ROOT Harness at emission time. Monotonically increasing within a workflow execution to support ordering guarantees.

event_type.description: Dotted event type identifier. The prefix identifies the category; the suffix identifies the specific action within that category.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

workflow_execution_id.description: Identifier of the workflow execution that produced this event. Matches the value returned by trigger_workflow and accepted by subscribe_events.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that emitted the event. For workflow-level events (workflow.*, checkpoint.*), this is the orchestrator. For node-level events, this is the agent executing the node.

agent_type.description: Agent taxonomy type of the emitting agent.

workflow_name.description: Name of the workflow definition. Present on workflow.* events.

input_params.description: Input parameters passed to trigger_workflow. Present on workflow.started.

output_summary.description: Summary of workflow outputs. Present on workflow.completed. Structure varies by workflow definition.

node_id.description: LangGraph node identifier. Present on node.*, tool.*, llm.*, governance.*, and checkpoint.* events to identify the execution context.

node_type.description: Node classification (e.g., 'agent_action', 'router', 'interrupt', 'merge'). Present on node.* events.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool invoked. For SAGE API calls, this is the operation name (e.g., 'discover', 'set_lifecycle'). For MCP tools, this is the MCP tool identifier. Present on tool.* events.

operation.description: The specific operation being performed. For tool.* events, mirrors tool_name for SAGE operations or provides the MCP method. For governance.* events, identifies the SAGE mutation operation (set_lifecycle, update_metadata, ingest, link).

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the tool call. Present on tool.call. Sensitive fields may be redacted based on domain configuration.

success.description: Whether the tool call or LLM request succeeded. Present on tool.result.

model.description: LLM model identifier. Present on llm.* events.

purpose.description: Human-readable description of why the LLM was invoked (e.g., 'generate semantic abstract', 'evaluate preconditions', 'plan next steps'). Present on llm.* events.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of prompt tokens consumed. Present on llm.response. May be an estimate on llm.request (as prompt_token_estimate).

completion_tokens.description: Number of completion tokens generated. Present on llm.response.

interrupt_id.description: Unique identifier for the interrupt instance. Present on interrupt.* events. Matches the ID used by the approve operation on the Orchestration API.

interrupt_type.description: Classification of the interrupt (e.g., 'checkpoint_review', 'approval_required', 'exception_escalation'). Domain instantiations may define additional types. Present on interrupt.* events.

interrupt_description.description: Human-readable description of what the interrupt is requesting. Present on interrupt.raised.

response_options.description: Available response options for this interrupt. Present on interrupt.raised.

resolution.description: The response option selected by the human. Present on interrupt.resolved.

resolved_by.description: User ID of the human who resolved the interrupt. Present on interrupt.resolved.

document_id.description: SAGE document ID that is the target of a governance action. Present on governance.* events.

mutation_description.description: Human-readable description of the proposed mutation. Present on governance.mutation_proposed.

requires_approval.description: Whether this mutation requires human approval per the agent's approval policy. Present on governance.mutation_proposed.

checkpoint_id.description: LangGraph checkpoint identifier. Present on checkpoint.* events.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds. Context-dependent: wall-clock time for a node execution (node.exited), tool call (tool.result), LLM round-trip (llm.response), or total workflow run (workflow.completed, workflow.failed).

error.description: Error details when an operation fails. Present on workflow.failed and tool.result (when success is false).

InterruptOption.description: A selectable response option presented to the human during an interrupt. This is an intentional subset of the authoritative InterruptOption in interrupt.schema.json, which additionally defines effect, requires_comment, and parameter_schema. The event stream carries only the fields needed for observability; the full option contract is available via the list_pending operation.

option_id.description: Machine-readable identifier for this option. Passed back in the approve operation and recorded in the interrupt.resolved event's resolution field.

label.description: Human-readable label displayed in the CAS Application.

description.description: Optional longer description of what this option does.

is_default.description: Whether this option is pre-selected in the CAS Application UI.

EventError.description: Error details attached to failure events.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. For SAGE failures, mirrors the SAGE Core API error code. For LLM failures, uses ROOT Harness error codes (e.g., 'llm_timeout', 'token_budget_exceeded').

detail.description: Additional context. Structure varies by error type.
